fusions.name: Disarming Bind
fusions.desc: Binds the weapon of one enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 8 damage, knocking it back 2 tiles and taking its next action away for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Two-Grip Strokes
fusions.desc: Two measured strokes, each dealing 6 damage, that leave the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Hilt in Both Fists
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Drilled Into the Wrist
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
